title: Sparkly glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='32' cy='52' r='17' fill='none' stroke='#8fd3ff' stroke-width='6'/>

  <circle cx='32' cy='52' r='14' fill='#2b6fa8' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='14' fill='#2b6fa8' opacity='0.55'/>

  <path d='M24 44 Q30 40 36 45' fill='none' stroke='#d9f4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M49 50 Q50 46 51 50' fill='none' stroke='#8fd3ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- small sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#fff3b0'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='14' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='16' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='52' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='56' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='90' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='72' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='70' r='1.8'/>
